roadmap.title: Open all eight stages
roadmap.description: Clear the normal route through VASTxVOID while collecting every blueprint and trying new Balls and Passives.

roadmap.title: Build and strengthen Ballbylon
roadmap.description: Construct homes and utility buildings, expand the town, concentrate stat upgrades, and arrange production corridors for the harvest thresholds.

roadmap.title: Complete the character-clear matrix
roadmap.description: Clear all eight normal stages with each base-game character; the first ten distinct clears per stage also finish every Conquered achievement.

roadmap.title: Finish recipes and the Encyclopedia
roadmap.description: Create the five named hidden recipes, fuse two evolved balls, and use the base-game Encyclopedia tabs to close every remaining entry.

achievements.description: Complete the BONExYARD
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{BONExYARD} once on the normal stage setting.

guide.context: A successful boss clear records the stage for the selected character; the faster post-clear variants are not required for the achievement set.

steps.text: Select @loc{BONExYARD} on its normal setting with any available character.
Survive the run and defeat the stage boss to record the clear.

achievements.description: Create your first evolution
achievements.summary: Create one ball evolution from two compatible level-3 Special Balls.

guide.context: An evolution is available only when both compatible components have reached level 3 and another Fusion Reactor is collected.

steps.text: During a run, take two compatible Special Balls and raise both to level 3.
Collect a Fusion Reactor and select the evolution offered for the level-3 pair.

achievements.description: Fuse two balls for the first time
achievements.summary: Fuse any two balls at a Fusion Reactor.

guide.context: Ordinary fusion does not require level-3 balls or a valid evolution recipe.

steps.text: Collect a Fusion Reactor during a stage run.
Choose any two owned balls in the fusion menu and confirm the fusion.

achievements.description: Create Nosferatu
achievements.summary: Evolve Vampire Lord, Mosquito King, and Spider Queen into @item{Nosferatu}.

guide.context: All three intermediate evolutions must be level 3 before the final three-way evolution appears.

steps.text: Raise Vampire and Bleed to level 3, then evolve them into Vampire Lord.
Raise Brood Mother and Vampire to level 3, then evolve them into Mosquito King.
Raise Brood Mother and Egg Sac to level 3, then evolve them into Spider Queen.
Raise Vampire Lord, Mosquito King, and Spider Queen to level 3, collect another Fusion Reactor, and evolve all three into @item{Nosferatu}.

achievements.description: Create a Nuclear Bomb
achievements.summary: Evolve Bomb and Poison into a @item{Nuclear Bomb}.

guide.context: The recipe is a two-stage chain, and every component used at each evolution must be level 3.

steps.text: Raise Burn and Iron to level 3, then evolve them into Bomb.
Raise Bomb and Poison to level 3, collect another Fusion Reactor, and evolve them into @item{Nuclear Bomb}.

achievements.description: Create Satan
achievements.summary: Evolve Incubus and Succubus into @item{Satan}.

guide.context: Both intermediate balls and their four base components must be raised to level 3 for the full chain.

steps.text: Raise Charm and Dark to level 3, then evolve them into Incubus.
Raise Charm and Vampire to level 3, then evolve them into Succubus.
Raise Incubus and Succubus to level 3, collect another Fusion Reactor, and evolve them into @item{Satan}.

achievements.description: Create a Soul Reaver
achievements.summary: Evolve Everflowing Goblet and Vampiric Sword into @item{Soul Reaver}.

guide.context: Soul Reaver is an evolved-passive recipe, so both named passives must be level 3 before using the Fusion Reactor.

steps.text: Acquire Everflowing Goblet and Vampiric Sword during one run and raise both to level 3.
Collect a Fusion Reactor and evolve Everflowing Goblet with Vampiric Sword into @item{Soul Reaver}.

achievements.description: Create Deadeye's Cross
achievements.summary: Evolve all four Hilted Daggers into @item{Deadeye's Cross}.

guide.context: The four-way passive recipe needs Sapphire, Diamond, Emerald, and Ruby Hilted Dagger in the same run, each at level 3.

steps.text: Acquire Sapphire Hilted Dagger, Diamond Hilted Dagger, Emerald Hilted Dagger, and Ruby Hilted Dagger in one run.
Raise all four Hilted Daggers to level 3.
Collect a Fusion Reactor and evolve the four daggers into @item{Deadeye's Cross}.

achievements.description: Kill 100,000 enemies
achievements.summary: Kill 100,000 enemies across all runs.

guide.context: Progress persists across runs and harvests, so no single attempt must supply the full total.

steps.text: Continue clearing stages and developing Ballbylon while accumulating enemy kills.
Keep collecting until the cumulative counter reaches 100,000 enemy kills.

achievements.description: Mine 1000 gold in a single harvest
achievements.summary: Collect 1,000 gold during one Ballbylon harvest.

guide.context: The threshold resets between harvests; a short, blocked corridor keeps workers rebounding through the same production buildings.

steps.text: Build and upgrade several Gold Mines.
Arrange the producers along a narrow dead-end corridor so launched workers cannot escape after one collision.
Select @mechanic{Harvest}, launch every available character into the corridor, and keep the single-harvest total at or above 1,000 gold.

achievements.description: Collect 50 blueprints
achievements.summary: Pick up 50 blueprint drops across stage runs.

guide.context: Blueprint scrolls can drop from defeated enemies and permanently add their structures to Ballbylon's build menu.

steps.text: During stage runs, move over every dropped blueprint scroll before it disappears.
Continue clearing stages and collecting new scrolls until 50 blueprints have been recorded.

achievements.description: Construct a trophy
achievements.summary: Finish constructing one stage Trophy in Ballbylon.

guide.context: Completing a stage awards its Trophy blueprint, but the achievement waits for the placed building's construction meter to be filled.

steps.text: Complete any stage to receive that stage's Trophy blueprint.
In Ballbylon's build menu, spend the required materials and place the Trophy.
Select @mechanic{Harvest} and bounce characters into the construction site until its meter fills.

achievements.description: Construct an infinitely upgradeable building
achievements.summary: Finish constructing any infinitely upgradeable building.

guide.context: Blueprints for infinitely upgradeable stat buildings become available in @loc{VASTxVOID}.

steps.text: Collect an infinitely upgradeable building blueprint while clearing @loc{VASTxVOID}.
Return to Ballbylon, spend the required materials, and place that building.
Select @mechanic{Harvest} and bounce characters into the construction site until its meter fills.

achievements.description: Construct the Relic Collector
achievements.summary: Finish constructing the @loc{Relic Collector} in Ballbylon.

guide.context: Placing a blueprint starts construction; the achievement registers only after the building's completion meter is filled.

steps.text: Collect the @loc{Relic Collector} blueprint from a stage drop.
Return to Ballbylon, spend the required materials, and place the @loc{Relic Collector}.
Select @mechanic{Harvest} and bounce characters into the construction site until its meter fills.

achievements.description: Expand your base 5 times
achievements.summary: Buy five Ballbylon land expansions.

guide.context: Expansion is the second option on the left side of the base-building menu, and each purchase raises the next gold price.

steps.text: Open Ballbylon's base-building controls and select the second option on the left.
Spend gold on five separate land expansions.

achievements.description: Reach +5 bonus in any attribute from a building
achievements.summary: Upgrade one flat-stat building until it grants a +5 attribute bonus.

guide.context: Each upgrade adds +1 to that building's listed attribute, so one qualifying structure must receive five upgrades.

steps.text: Build a flat-stat structure such as the Gunsmith, Consulate, Shoemaker, Barracks, Schoolhouse, or Clinic.
Invest resources and harvest construction progress until that same building reaches +5.

achievements.description: Reach S stat scaling in any attribute
achievements.summary: Upgrade one stat-scaling building until its listed attribute reaches S rank.

guide.context: Scaling buildings advance a character stat through letter grades; concentrating five upgrades in one qualifying building reaches S.

steps.text: Build a scaling structure such as the Alchemist, Military Academy, Wheelwright, Archery Range, Diplomacy Hall, or University.
Apply and finish five upgrades on that same structure until its listed scaling grade becomes S.

achievements.description: Build 15 housing structures
achievements.summary: Fully construct 15 character housing structures in Ballbylon.

guide.context: A house counts only when its construction meter is complete, which also makes its resident character playable.

steps.text: Collect character-home blueprints from stage drops.
Place 15 different housing structures and pay their required materials.
Use @mechanic{Harvest} to bounce characters into every construction site until all 15 meters are filled.

achievements.description: Fuse two evolved balls
achievements.summary: Fuse two already evolved balls at a Fusion Reactor.

guide.context: The final fusion combines both evolved effects into one slot; it does not need to create a named second-tier recipe.

steps.text: Create two separate evolved balls during the same run.
Collect another Fusion Reactor, select the two evolved balls, and confirm the fusion.

achievements.description: Unlock every entry in the Encyclopedia
achievements.summary: Unlock every base-game Ball, Passive, and Monster entry in the Encyclopedia.

guide.context: A Ball or Passive entry records after the item is selected during a run; Monster entries fill through kills, while evolved entries require their level-3 recipes.

steps.text: Complete all eight normal stages so their enemies and stage-unlocked item pools become available.
Open the base-game Balls tab, select every missing base ball during runs, and create every missing level-3 evolution.

Open the base-game Passives tab, select every missing passive, and create every missing passive evolution. For the common holdouts, carry any Sword, Bow, or Healer statue passive to make Heart, Shield, and Traitor's Hood eligible, and carry a curse-type ball to make Voodoo Doll eligible.
Open the base-game Monsters tab and defeat any enemy whose entry remains missing.
Recheck each base-game tab until no silhouette or undiscovered recipe remains.

achievements.description: Complete the game
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{VASTxVOID} with eight different characters.

guide.context: The ending triggers on the eighth distinct VASTxVOID clear, two characters before the separate VASTxVOID Conquered achievement.

steps.text: Progress through the normal stages until @loc{VASTxVOID} is available.
Defeat the @loc{VASTxVOID} boss with eight distinct characters.
Complete the ending sequence after the eighth distinct clear.
